title: selfcheck's host line over both load limits is still cut when an old host lock is reported beside it
goal: check_host's line over both load limits with an old host lock fits LINE_MAX with each remedy readable, no [cut]

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_selfcheck, bl_stall
age = bl_stall.HOST_LOCK_WAIT_S + 60
bl_selfcheck.lock_facts = lambda now: [("main", 4242, "/tmp/clone-a", age)]
line = bl_selfcheck.line_of(bl_selfcheck.check_host(load=30.0, cores=14))
print(len(line), line[-60:])
sys.exit(1 if "[cut]" in line else 0)
